description: Source code for QuicSendControlStream class implementing HTTP/QUIC control stream functionalities such as sending settings, priority updates, and go-away frames within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicSendControlStream
classes.description: Class managing the QUIC send control stream, handling settings, priority updates, and go-away frames.

methods.name: QuicSendControlStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control stream with stream ID, session, and settings.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, logs bug if called.

methods.name: OnStopSending
methods.description: Handles stop sending signals, reports error to delegate.

methods.name: MaybeSendSettingsFrame
methods.description: Sends the settings frame if not already sent, including greasing frames for HTTP/3.

methods.name: WritePriorityUpdate
methods.description: Sends a priority update frame for a specific stream.

methods.name: SendGoAway
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame indicating stream termination.
